title: Unmatched Does Not Mean False: Incomplete Reference Sets Can Reverse Calibration Rankings in Open-Ended Theory-of-Mind Tracking
abstract: arXiv:2608.25654v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Open-ended Theory-of-Mind (ToM) trackers emit valid beliefs absent from finite references. A finite-reference-plus-matcher pipeline marks unmatched outputs false, creating proxy labels that can reverse proper-score model selection on fixed outputs. Holding 259 beliefs and paired scores fixed, reference recoding lowers weighted prevalence from 0.783 to 0.295 and reverses strictly proper Brier risk: a frozen source-prior rule leads native confidence by 0.227 under reference labels and trails by 0.152 under blinded adjudication, in all six authored scenarios. A reference-only Platt recalibrator reverses further. An ICE-specific reversal appears in a released 301-question NQ-open DPR-BERT pipeline: its average-confidence baseline improves instance-level calibration error by 0.045 under exact match but worsens it by 0.074 under human correctness, with both intervals excluding zero. translated_title: 不匹配并不意味着错误：不完整的参考集可能颠倒开放式心智理论追踪中的校准排名
translated_abstract: 开放式心智理论（ToM）追踪器会生成有限参考集中不存在的有效信念。有限参考加匹配器的流程会将不匹配的输出标记为错误，从而产生代理标签，这些标签可能颠倒固定输出上的正确评分模型选择。在保持259个信念和配对分数不变的情况下，参考重新编码将加权患病率从0.783降至0.295，并颠倒了严格正确的Brier风险：一个固定的源先验规则在参考标签下领先原生置信度0.227，而在盲审下落后0.152，这在全部六个作者设定的场景中均成立。仅使用参考的Platt重新校准器进一步颠倒了结果。在发布的301个问题的NQ-open DPR-BERT流程中，出现了特定的ICE反转：其平均置信度基线在精确匹配下将实例级校准误差改善了0.045，但在人类正确性下却恶化了0.074，且两个区间均排除零。在独立撰写的OpenToM叙事中，90-96%的审计...
tldr: 本文揭示不完整的参考集在开放式心智理论追踪中会颠倒校准排名，导致模型选择出现系统性偏差。
en_tdlr: This paper reveals that incomplete reference sets can reverse calibration rankings in open-ended Theory-of-Mind tracking, causing systematic bias in model selection.
